    Ratings

    Overall star rating

    The overall star rating is based on how well a hospital performs across different areas of quality, such as treating heart attacks and pneumonia, readmission rates, and safety of care.

    Learn how Medicare calculates this rating

    Patient survey rating

    The patient survey rating measures patients' experiences of their care. Recent patients were asked about important topics like how well nurses and doctors communicated and treated patients, and how well staff prepared patients to recover at home, and the cleanliness of the facility.

    Learn how the inpatient survey rating is measured
